title: Far too slow for a cup of coffee!
text: Far too slow for a cup of coffee!. It's half the size of my old coffee maker and takes four times as long to make half the amount of coffee. I didn't even make coffee I just ran water through it to clean it and I swear it took 15 minutes I should have timed it could be longer. For a toy coffee maker such as this it is not even worth the money even though it was quite an expensive
